notes.title: The game is out - enjoy the demo version! ✨
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Demo is out - it's time to jump into the Magic Pussy universe once again in its prequel, telling the story of young Percival trying to solve the mystery of powerful artifacts and an enigmatic cult all while exploring a cozy village of Wisterwood. 

If you've played the previous chapters - note that this demo is longer than the whole chapter 1, so it's definitely worth a try! A whole week of story, a new approach to animations and a varying plot with choices that influence the outcomes - the full version will feature many different endings. 

Dive into the game and feel free to let us know about your experience - consider joining our Discord server for fast support and direct connection with a developer team. Violet's back, young versions of well-known characters are here and a lot of new enticing ones are waiting for you - all spiced-up with a long-awaited introduction of longer animated scenes and orgasms! 

This demo gives you just a glimpse - we’re working on 4 more weeks of content that will be available in the full version!

Download the demo now and experience the adventure for yourself - we'll keep the work going! 🎮

notes.title: By popular demand – CUM is here! 💦
notes.content:
Your request, our action 😉

People have been asking us to add visualized orgasms for quite some time, and we're now delivering them, and delivering generously - bucket after the bucket! As we've said before, we're working on some mind-blowing animations that will change the way you look at such games - after all, art is art. If you're interested in checking out a few screenshots and a little glimpse into upcoming animations - jump into our Discord and check it out! 

Also, we'll post a devlog soon - free demo is getting closer, and it will be released in the middle of October, so wishlist the game and stick to our news.

Thank you for playing the previous chapters and for your feedback guys!

notes.title: Development is in full swing! 🔮
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

The series is back, and we're currently actively working on a new chapter - as we mentioned before, a prequel to the previous chapters. You'll be playing as a Jeannie's grandfather - a carefree redheaded trickster, and you'll meet young Irma, Kurdupel and other old and new characters - Violet's back too!

Get ready for 5 weeks of a long, detailed, branching and well-written story with many different endings and routes to go on, almost 20 characters, more than half of which are major ones with their own motives, backgrounds and role in the story, a completely new approach to animations and new approach to mini-games and choices - you're up for an adventure never seen before!

Wishlist the game and join our Discord so you won't miss any news and updates - free demo will be out in October!
